_what: The column rights tool:check-a-words-ask-token needs from the words database's writer login (run-sql-in-my-database role recipe may-write-named-columns-under-a-use, recipe.writes). The words table is the one the site's row names as words_table: give its entry with that table's own name in place of <words_table>. The asks database is read with its reader login, which only reads. test/check-a-words-ask.test.ts runs the tool as logins holding exactly these. The words table's rows are opened by the ask: the tool presents the ask's token in its transaction (use_binding.present_key) and the login reaches only the row whose ask_key_digest holds that token's digest, which the ask writes when it makes the row (the login adds no row of its own: a row it adds has no presented digest, so the rule refuses it); it may never write words_state's approved_identity, so it cannot approve words for showing.
